name: noland-foresight-ghost
why: The trainer AI's score for Foresight when the Foresight user is a Ghost type (fix 41, docs/parity-mac/ai-foresight-ghost-second-roll.md). Silver Noland leads with Machoke (set 283: Cross Chop, Rock Slide, Foresight, Scary Face), a Fighting type. The player's Jumpluff (set 334) puts it to sleep, Kecleon (set 325) gives it Color Change with Skill Swap, Banette (set 342) hits it with Shadow Ball: Machoke is a Ghost type. From then on the AI scores Machoke's Foresight every turn with the two random rolls of AI_CV_Foresight2 and AI_CV_Foresight3 (data/battle_ai_scripts.s:1957-1961). The engine before fix 41 rolled once and leaves the ROM's battle in the first such turn.
